You are an adversarial verifier for a proposed STRUCTURAL refactor in the andesim repo at /home/nick/work/andesim.
READ-ONLY: do not edit, build, or run anything. Use Read/Grep/Glob only.

Claim (from reviewer scripts):
- file: scripts/run_e2e.sh:63
- category: duplication
- title: REQUIRED_ELFS hand-duplicates the RT_TESTS fixture list and has drifted by 6 fixtures
- detail: REQUIRED_ELFS (lines 63-69) exists only to decide whether to run `make -C tests/fixtures -j` (lines 70-77), but it is a second hand-maintained copy of the fixture names already encoded in RT_TESTS (lines 83-108) and SERIAL_RT_TESTS (lines 124-127). It has drifted: RT_TESTS drives rt_m_ext_counters, rt_m_ext_trigcause, rt_c_static_buf, rt_c_dlm_data, rt_c_ilm_code, and rt_c_hvm_data (all present in tests/fixtures/ and tests/fixtures/Makefile lines 32, 51-52), yet none of the six appear in REQUIRED_ELFS. On a checkout where the older ELFs exist but any of these six is missing (e.g. a stale build dir after pulling the commit that added them), need_build stays 0, the auto-build guard does not fire, and those tests FAIL with a missing ELF instead of rebuilding. Structural fix: derive the required set from the FIXTURE= fields of RT_TESTS + SERIAL_RT_TESTS instead of a second literal list.
- claimed safety: When all ELFs are present (the normal case) the derived check evaluates the same way and no make runs, so behavior is identical. When some are missing it triggers the exact same `make -C tests/fixtures -j` already used for the older fixtures; the Makefile builds all fixtures anyway, so no new build steps are introduced.

Try to REFUTE it. For dead-code: grep the WHOLE repo (and the demo suite at /home/nick/work/andesim-demo, and consider that vsim lives in a separate repo /home/nick/work/vsim_andesim - grep there too if the symbol could cross repos) for references. For duplication: read both sites fully and check they really are behavior-identical. For stale-doc: read the doc AND the code it describes. For bug-report: check whether the behavior is actually wrong vs intended. If the change could alter ANY observable behavior (output text, exit codes, file layout, test expectations), verdict RISKY with the exact risk. If the claim is wrong, REJECTED. Only CONFIRMED when you verified the evidence yourself.

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Run the hybrid e2e tests. Drives tests/*.sh against pre-built artifacts
3	# (source ./setup.sh first to export the external qemu/vsim locations).
4	#
5	# Env overrides:
6	#   VSIM_QEMU    qemu-system-riscv64 (default: $QEMU_BIN_DIR/qemu-system-riscv64)
7	#   VSIM_PLUGIN  libhybrid_handoff.so (default: qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so)
8	#   VSIM_BIN     sim_<cpu> (default: first sim_* under $VSIM_BIN_DIR)
9	#   FILTER       regex; only run tests whose name matches
10	#   MODE         marker | pc | both  (default: both) - drives TRIGGER_MODE
11	#                for round-trip fixtures. Negative drivers run once
12	#                regardless because they assert orchestrator failure
13	#                modes orthogonal to the trigger mechanism.
14	#   JOBS         parallel job slots (default: min($(nproc),
15	#                free(/dev/shm)/256MB)). Each Tier-2 slot uses a 128 MB
16	#                /dev/shm mmap and runs 2 processes (qemu1, vsim); the
17	#                headroom check leaves margin for that plus QEMU's own
18	#                scratch. Pass JOBS=1 for sequential semantics.
19	#   LOG_DIR      where per-test logs land (default: mktemp -d under /tmp)
20	
21	set -euo pipefail
22	
23	ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
24	# vsim sim_* live in the external VSIM_BIN_DIR (setup.sh exports it, mirroring
25	# VSIM_QEMU); empty when setup.sh has not run -- the require below reports it.
26	VSIM_BUILD="${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-}"
27	HARNESS="$ROOT/tests"
28	TEST_DIR="$ROOT/tests/fixtures"
29	
30	VSIM_QEMU="${VSIM_QEMU:-${QEMU_BIN_DIR:-}/qemu-system-riscv64}"
31	VSIM_PLUGIN="${VSIM_PLUGIN:-$ROOT/qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so}"
32	if [[ -z "${VSIM_BIN:-}" ]]; then
33	  # Default to the repo's canonical SINGLE-HART engine (the same one ./andesim
34	  # pins). The fixtures are single-hart programs: on a multicore build like
35	  # sim_ax45mpv_mp2 -- which sorts FIRST under $VSIM_BIN_DIR -- the
36	  # secondary hart runs crt0 from reset, writes SKIPPED to SimControl and
37	  # stops the sim before hart 0 drains, failing every C fixture. Fall back
38	  # to the first sim_* only when the canonical engine is not built.
39	  VSIM_BIN="$VSIM_BUILD/sim_ax45mpv_premium"
40	  if [[ ! -x "$VSIM_BIN" ]]; then
41	    VSIM_BIN=$(ls "$VSIM_BUILD"/sim_* 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
42	  fi
43	fi
44	
45	step() { printf '\033[1;34m==>\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
46	ok()   { printf '\033[1;32m[ok]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
47	warn() { printf '\033[1;33m[skip]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
48	fail() { printf '\033[1;31m[FAIL]\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
49	
50	require() {
51	  if [[ -z "$2" || ! -e "$2" ]]; then
52	    fail "$1 not found: $2"
53	    fail "build artifacts first: 'source ./setup.sh'"
54	    exit 1
55	  fi
56	}
57	require VSIM_QEMU   "$VSIM_QEMU"
58	require VSIM_PLUGIN "$VSIM_PLUGIN"
59	require VSIM_BIN    "$VSIM_BIN"
60	
61	export VSIM_QEMU VSIM_PLUGIN VSIM_BIN
62	
63	REQUIRED_ELFS=(
64	  handoff_roundtrip rt_pc_jump rt_sign_bits rt_abi_aliases rt_long_roi
65	  rt_all_gprs rt_mem_loadstore rt_unaligned_lh rt_csr_survival rt_shared_mem
66	  rt_priv_smode rt_priv_umode
67	  rt_c_hello rt_c_printf rt_c_matmul rt_c_fcsr rt_c_v_regs rt_c_v_csrs
68	  rt_c_v_matmul rt_c_v_fill
69	)
70	need_build=0
71	for f in "${REQUIRED_ELFS[@]}"; do
72	  [[ -e "$TEST_DIR/$f.elf" ]] || need_build=1
73	done
74	if (( need_build )); then
75	  step "building test ELFs in $TEST_DIR"
76	  make -C "$TEST_DIR" -j
77	fi
78	
79	# Round-trip fixtures: name|fixture-env-prefix. All run on the unified
80	# e2e.sh harness (shared /dev/shm mmap). The TRIGGER_MODE env is
81	# injected per iteration based on $MODE. Negative drivers live in
82	# NEG_TESTS and run once regardless of mode.
83	RT_TESTS=(
84	  "handoff_roundtrip|FIXTURE=handoff_roundtrip"
85	  "rt_pc_jump|FIXTURE=rt_pc_jump"
86	  "rt_sign_bits|FIXTURE=rt_sign_bits"
87	  "rt_abi_aliases|FIXTURE=rt_abi_aliases"
88	  "rt_long_roi|FIXTURE=rt_long_roi"
89	  "rt_all_gprs|FIXTURE=rt_all_gprs"
90	  "rt_mem_loadstore|FIXTURE=rt_mem_loadstore"
91	  "rt_unaligned_lh|FIXTURE=rt_unaligned_lh"
92	  "rt_csr_survival|FIXTURE=rt_csr_survival"
93	  "rt_m_ext_counters|FIXTURE=rt_m_ext_counters"
94	  "rt_m_ext_trigcause|FIXTURE=rt_m_ext_trigcause"
95	  "rt_shared_mem|FIXTURE=rt_shared_mem"
96	  "rt_c_hello|FIXTURE=rt_c_hello"
97	  "rt_c_printf|FIXTURE=rt_c_printf"
98	  "rt_c_matmul|FIXTURE=rt_c_matmul TIMEOUT=120"
99	  "rt_c_fcsr|FIXTURE=rt_c_fcsr"
100	  "rt_c_v_regs|FIXTURE=rt_c_v_regs"
101	  "rt_c_v_csrs|FIXTURE=rt_c_v_csrs"
102	  "rt_c_v_matmul|FIXTURE=rt_c_v_matmul TIMEOUT=120"
103	  "rt_c_v_fill|FIXTURE=rt_c_v_fill"
104	  "rt_c_static_buf|FIXTURE=rt_c_static_buf"
105	  "rt_c_dlm_data|FIXTURE=rt_c_dlm_data CHECK_VSIM_STDOUT=DLM_OK CHECK_LM_EXIT_SIDECARS=1 TIMEOUT=120"
106	  "rt_c_ilm_code|FIXTURE=rt_c_ilm_code CHECK_VSIM_STDOUT=ILM_OK CHECK_LM_EXIT_SIDECARS=1"
107	  "rt_c_hvm_data|FIXTURE=rt_c_hvm_data CHECK_VSIM_STDOUT=HVM_OK CHECK_LM_EXIT_SIDECARS=1 TIMEOUT=120"
108	)
109	
110	NEG_TESTS=(
111	  "rt_corrupt_state|bash $HARNESS/drivers/rt_corrupt_state.sh"
112	  "rt_lm_transport_off|bash $HARNESS/drivers/rt_lm_transport_off.sh"
113	  "rt_hvm_transport_off|bash $HARNESS/drivers/rt_hvm_transport_off.sh"
114	)
115	
116	# Heavyweight round-trip fixtures, run SEQUENTIALLY after the parallel
117	# pool drains. The L6 privilege fixtures need an S/U-capable engine pair
118	# (the default ax45mpv_premium RTL is M-mode-only,
119	# NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS=1), and the only built RV64 one is
120	# ax66_makatau -- whose Verilator binary runs 32 threads. Two of those in
121	# the parallel pool saturate the box and time out BOTH themselves and the
122	# lighter default-engine tests, so they get the machine to themselves.
123	# Same entry format as RT_TESTS; both trigger modes still apply.
124	SERIAL_RT_TESTS=(
125	  "rt_priv_smode|FIXTURE=rt_priv_smode CHECK_PRIV=1 TIMEOUT=300 VSIM_BIN=$VSIM_BUILD/sim_ax66_makatau QEMU_CPU=andes-ax66,vlen=128"
126	  "rt_priv_umode|FIXTURE=rt_priv_umode CHECK_PRIV=0 TIMEOUT=300 VSIM_BIN=$VSIM_BUILD/sim_ax66_makatau QEMU_CPU=andes-ax66,vlen=128"
127	)
128	
129	MODE="${MODE:-both}"
130	case "$MODE" in
131	  marker|pc|both) ;;
132	  *) fail "MODE must be one of marker|pc|both (got: $MODE)"; exit 1 ;;
133	esac
134	
135	default_jobs() {
136	  local n=1 shm_free shm_cap
137	  n=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 1)
138	  if [[ -d /dev/shm ]]; then
139	    shm_free=$(df -m --output=avail /dev/shm 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2 | tr -d ' ')
140	    if [[ "$shm_free" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$shm_free" -gt 0 ]]; then
141	      shm_cap=$((shm_free / 256))
142	      (( shm_cap < n && shm_cap >= 1 )) && n=$shm_cap
143	    fi
144	  fi
145	  (( n < 1 )) && n=1
146	  printf '%d\n' "$n"
147	}
148	JOBS="${JOBS:-$(default_jobs)}"
149	[[ "$JOBS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$JOBS" -ge 1 ]] \
150	  || { fail "JOBS must be a positive integer (got: $JOBS)"; exit 1; }
151	
152	FILTER="${FILTER:-}"
153	
154	LOG_DIR="${LOG_DIR:-$(mktemp -d -t e2e-XXXXXX)}"
155	mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
156	RESULTS_FILE="$LOG_DIR/results.tsv"
157	LOCK_FILE="$LOG_DIR/lock"
158	: > "$RESULTS_FILE"
159	: > "$LOCK_FILE"
160	
161	# run_one MODE NAME CMD INDEX TOTAL
162	# Captures the test command's stdout+stderr into $LOG_DIR/$mode--$name.log,
163	# emits one atomic progress line, and appends a TSV row to $RESULTS_FILE
164	# (mode<TAB>name<TAB>status<TAB>rc<TAB>elapsed). flock on $LOCK_FILE
165	# serializes the progress write and the results-file append so concurrent
166	# children (introduced by the parallel-execution commit) cannot interleave
167	# their TTY writes or corrupt the tally file.
168	run_one() {
169	  local mode="$1" name="$2" cmd="$3" idx="$4" total="$5"
170	  local log="$LOG_DIR/$mode--$name.log"
171	  local start end elapsed status rc
172	  start=$(date +%s)
173	  set +e
174	  bash -c "$cmd" >"$log" 2>&1
175	  rc=$?
176	  set -e
177	  end=$(date +%s)
178	  elapsed=$((end - start))
179	  case $rc in
180	    0)  status=PASS ;;
181	    77) status=SKIP ;;
182	    *)  status=FAIL ;;
183	  esac
184	  (
185	    flock 9
186	    case "$status" in
187	      PASS) ok   "[$idx/$total] ${name}[${mode}] (${elapsed}s)" ;;
188	      SKIP) warn "[$idx/$total] ${name}[${mode}] (rc=77, ${elapsed}s)" ;;
189	      FAIL) fail "[$idx/$total] ${name}[${mode}] (rc=$rc, ${elapsed}s) -> $log" ;;
190	    esac
191	    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%d\t%d\n' \
192	      "$mode" "$name" "$status" "$rc" "$elapsed" >> "$RESULTS_FILE"
193	  ) 9>"$LOCK_FILE"
194	}
195	
196	# Build the workplan: one entry per (mode, name, cmd) tuple. Order
197	# matters: marker-mode tests first, then pc-mode, then negatives (matching
198	# the original sequential layout so logs are streamed in the same order).
199	declare -a WORKPLAN=()
200	for tm in marker pc; do
201	  [[ "$MODE" != "both" && "$MODE" != "$tm" ]] && continue
202	  for entry in "${RT_TESTS[@]}"; do
203	    rt_name="${entry%%|*}"
204	    env_prefix="${entry#*|}"
205	    # B3: anchor the regex so FILTER=rt_csr does not silently also match
206	    # rt_csr_survival. Users who want a substring match pass '.*marker.*'.
207	    [[ -n "$FILTER" && ! "$rt_name" =~ ^$FILTER$ ]] && continue
208	    cmd="TRIGGER_MODE=$tm $env_prefix bash $HARNESS/e2e.sh"
209	    WORKPLAN+=("$tm|$rt_name|$cmd")
210	  done
211	done
212	for entry in "${NEG_TESTS[@]}"; do
213	  neg_name="${entry%%|*}"
214	  neg_cmd="${entry#*|}"
215	  [[ -n "$FILTER" && ! "$neg_name" =~ ^$FILTER$ ]] && continue
216	  WORKPLAN+=("neg|$neg_name|$neg_cmd")
217	done
218	
219	# Serial phase: same (mode, name, cmd) tuples, executed one at a time
220	# after the parallel pool drains (see SERIAL_RT_TESTS above for why).
221	declare -a SERIAL_PLAN=()
222	for tm in marker pc; do
223	  [[ "$MODE" != "both" && "$MODE" != "$tm" ]] && continue
224	  for entry in "${SERIAL_RT_TESTS[@]}"; do
225	    rt_name="${entry%%|*}"
226	    env_prefix="${entry#*|}"
227	    [[ -n "$FILTER" && ! "$rt_name" =~ ^$FILTER$ ]] && continue
228	    cmd="TRIGGER_MODE=$tm $env_prefix bash $HARNESS/e2e.sh"
229	    SERIAL_PLAN+=("$tm|$rt_name|$cmd")
230	  done
231	done
232	
233	TOTAL=$(( ${#WORKPLAN[@]} + ${#SERIAL_PLAN[@]} ))
234	step "logs: $LOG_DIR  jobs: $JOBS  mode: $MODE  tests: $TOTAL"
235	
236	# FIFO-based bounded job pool. Each child reads one token from $SEM_FIFO
237	# before starting and writes one back on exit; only $JOBS tokens exist,
238	# so at most $JOBS children run concurrently. Opening the fifo in
239	# read-write mode (<>) means writes never block the parent. The fifo
240	# inode is unlinked immediately after fd 8 is bound -- the kernel keeps
241	# the pipe alive as long as fd 8 is open.
242	SEM_FIFO="$LOG_DIR/sem.fifo"
243	mkfifo "$SEM_FIFO"

246	for ((sem_i=0; sem_i<JOBS; sem_i++)); do

248	done

250	i=0
251	for w in "${WORKPLAN[@]}"; do
252	  i=$((i+1))
253	  w_mode="${w%%|*}"
254	  w_rest="${w#*|}"
255	  w_name="${w_rest%%|*}"
256	  w_cmd="${w_rest#*|}"
257	  read -r -u 8 _tok
258	  (
259	    run_one "$w_mode" "$w_name" "$w_cmd" "$i" "$TOTAL"
260	    printf '.\n' >&8
261	  ) &
262	done
263	wait
264	exec 8>&-
265	
266	# Serial phase: each heavyweight test gets the machine to itself.
267	for w in "${SERIAL_PLAN[@]}"; do
268	  i=$((i+1))
269	  w_mode="${w%%|*}"
270	  w_rest="${w#*|}"
271	  w_name="${w_rest%%|*}"
272	  w_cmd="${w_rest#*|}"

274	done

276	declare -A MODE_PASS=([marker]=0 [pc]=0 [neg]=0)
277	declare -A MODE_FAIL=([marker]=0 [pc]=0 [neg]=0)
278	declare -A MODE_SKIP=([marker]=0 [pc]=0 [neg]=0)
279	declare -a FAILED_NAMES=()
280	while IFS=$'\t' read -r r_mode r_name r_status _r_rc _r_el; do
281	  case "$r_status" in
282	    PASS) MODE_PASS[$r_mode]=$((MODE_PASS[$r_mode]+1)) ;;
283	    SKIP) MODE_SKIP[$r_mode]=$((MODE_SKIP[$r_mode]+1)) ;;
284	    FAIL) MODE_FAIL[$r_mode]=$((MODE_FAIL[$r_mode]+1));
285	          FAILED_NAMES+=("${r_name}[${r_mode}]") ;;
286	  esac
287	done < "$RESULTS_FILE"
288	
289	# Stream failed-test logs in workplan order so the user sees a
290	# deterministic post-run failure dump.
291	for w in "${WORKPLAN[@]}" "${SERIAL_PLAN[@]}"; do
292	  w_mode="${w%%|*}"
293	  w_rest="${w#*|}"
294	  w_name="${w_rest%%|*}"

296	                 '$1==m&&$2==n{print $3; exit}' "$RESULTS_FILE")
297	  if [[ "$w_status" == "FAIL" ]]; then
298	    echo
299	    echo "=== FAIL log: ${w_name}[${w_mode}] ==="

301	  fi
302	done

304	echo
305	marker_p=${MODE_PASS[marker]} marker_f=${MODE_FAIL[marker]} marker_s=${MODE_SKIP[marker]}
306	pc_p=${MODE_PASS[pc]}   pc_f=${MODE_FAIL[pc]}   pc_s=${MODE_SKIP[pc]}
307	neg_p=${MODE_PASS[neg]} neg_f=${MODE_FAIL[neg]} neg_s=${MODE_SKIP[neg]}
308	total_pass=$((marker_p + pc_p + neg_p))
309	total_fail=$((marker_f + pc_f + neg_f))
310	total_skip=$((marker_s + pc_s + neg_s))
311	step "summary: marker ${marker_p}p/${marker_f}f/${marker_s}s  pc ${pc_p}p/${pc_f}f/${pc_s}s  neg ${neg_p}p/${neg_f}f/${neg_s}s  total ${total_pass} passed, ${total_fail} failed, ${total_skip} skipped"
312	if (( total_fail > 0 )); then
313	  fail "failures: ${FAILED_NAMES[*]}"

42	#                   fixture on another engine, e.g. the S/U-capable
43	#                   ax66_makatau for the rt_priv_* fixtures (the default
44	#                   ax45mpv_premium RTL is M-mode-only).
45	
46	set -euo pipefail
47	
48	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
49	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/paths.sh"
50	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/roi.sh"
51	
52	FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:?FIXTURE env var is required (e.g. FIXTURE=rt_c_hello)}"
53	TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-60}"
54	TRIGGER_MODE="${TRIGGER_MODE:-marker}"
55	QEMU_CPU="${QEMU_CPU:-andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512}"
56	
57	hybrid_resolve_paths
58	
59	NM="${NM:-${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:+$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-nm}}"
60	NM="${NM:-riscv64-unknown-elf-nm}"
61	
62	case "$TRIGGER_MODE" in
63	  marker) ;;
64	  pc)
65	    if ! command -v "$NM" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
66	      echo "skip[$FIXTURE pc]: nm not found at $NM"
67	      exit 77
68	    fi
69	    # ROI_START / ROI_END name the two switch PCs (0x address or symbol in
70	    # $VSIM_ELF). ./andesim run always passes them explicitly. When a caller
71	    # leaves BOTH unset (e.g. the bulk runner scripts/run_e2e.sh), derive them
72	    # from the fixture's ROI marker HINTs via objdump, so pc mode needs no
73	    # per-fixture config and no planted boundary symbols. A partial set or a
74	    # derivation miss falls through to roi_resolve_pair's required-vars error.
75	    if [ -z "${ROI_START:-}" ] && [ -z "${ROI_END:-}" ]; then
76	      OBJDUMP="${OBJDUMP:-${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:+$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-objdump}}"
77	      OBJDUMP="${OBJDUMP:-riscv64-unknown-elf-objdump}"
78	      if command -v "$OBJDUMP" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
79	         && MARKERS=$(roi_markers_from_disasm "$("$OBJDUMP" -d "$VSIM_ELF")"); then
80	        ROI_START="0x${MARKERS%% *}"
81	        ROI_END="0x${MARKERS##* }"
82	        export ROI_START ROI_END
83	      fi
84	    fi
85	    NM_OUT=$("$NM" --defined-only "$VSIM_ELF")
86	    roi_resolve_pair "$NM_OUT" "$FIXTURE pc" || exit 1
87	    ;;
88	  *)
89	    echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: unknown TRIGGER_MODE=$TRIGGER_MODE (use marker|pc)"
90	    exit 1
91	    ;;
92	esac
93	
94	# 128 MB program RAM matches the QEMU virt machine default. L26/F2: the
95	# physical mmap reserves one V-scratch page (HYBRID_V_SCRATCH_BYTES =
96	# 32 * HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX) ABOVE the program's RAM, so the V-transport
97	# scratch (vsim parks it at the mmap top page) sits past anything the program
98	# can address. Mirrors the andesim driver (shm.cpp physical_mmap_bytes).
99	# Read HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX from the shared ABI so this tracks the header
100	# (the ceiling moved 64 -> 128 once already) instead of hardcoding it.
101	VLEN_BYTES_MAX=$(awk '/^#define HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX/ {print $3}' \
102	  "$SCRIPT_DIR/../include/hybrid/state_abi.h")
103	[ -n "$VLEN_BYTES_MAX" ] || { echo "e2e: cannot read HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX from state_abi.h" >&2; exit 1; }
104	PROGRAM_SIZE=$((128 * 1024 * 1024))
105	V_SCRATCH_BYTES=$((32 * VLEN_BYTES_MAX))
106	SHARED_SIZE=$((PROGRAM_SIZE + V_SCRATCH_BYTES))
107	SHARED_MEM=$(mktemp -p /dev/shm vsim-e2e-shared.XXXXXX)
108	STATE_QEMU=$(mktemp)
109	STATE_VSIM=$(mktemp)
